datos.observacion: Every line on the statement is loaded, either on its own or through its note breakdown. The breakdowns add up exactly to their lines: Matchorganisation, Leistungsfussball Nachwuchs (income and expense), Events (income and expense), Merchandising income, Personalaufwand, Transferaufwand, Werbung und Sponsoring, and Administrations- und sonstiger Betriebsaufwand. No subtotals are loaded, and no amounts are duplicated or on the wrong side.
